items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: The interviewee is relaying a question from a third party ('He said, where did Red Dugall live?') and does not provide any personal anecdote or direct interaction with Red Dugall.

ctx.x: Yeah, okay. Ask him where did Red Dugall live? Where did he live?

Yeah, you might know. He said, where did Red Dugall live? Where did he live? Down in the first quarter, you know, when he was there. He died suddenly there. He died. I don't like his... Yeah. I said, what was he going to get talking about dying now? Ask him did he know Herb Moran? Did you know Herb Moran? Who?
